decisions.label: Amplicon Sequencing
decisions.description: A method for targeted DNA sequencing that uses oligonucleotide primers to amplify regions of interest, followed by next-generation sequencing for deep coverage of the region.

verification.note: NCIT:C204813 Amplicon Sequencing; exact concept match for AMPLICON library strategy.

decisions.label: ATAC-Seq
decisions.description: A molecular genetic technique that identifies accessible, or open, chromatin regions in a sample using Tn5 transposase, which preferentially inserts sequencing adaptors into accessible chromatin.

verification.note: NCIT:C156056 ATAC-Seq; exact label match (case-insensitive).

decisions.label: Bisulfite Sequencing
decisions.description: A molecular genetic technique that uses bisulfite to convert unmethylated cytosine residues to uracil residues, followed by sequencing to distinguish methylated from unmethylated cytosine.

verification.note: NCIT:C106054 Bisulfite Sequencing; exact concept match for Bisulfite-Seq.

decisions.label: Chromatin Interaction Analysis with Paired-End Tag
decisions.description: A molecular genetic technique that combines chromatin immunoprecipitation with paired-end tag DNA sequencing to identify the nucleotide sequences for the binding sites occupied by DNA-associated proteins in a sample.

verification.note: NCIT:C172845 Chromatin Interaction Analysis with Paired-End Tag; ChIA-PET is the abbreviation for this method.

decisions.label: ChIP-Seq
decisions.description: A molecular genetic technique that uses chromatin immunoprecipitation (ChIP) to isolate protein-associated DNA sequences, which are then subjected to next-generation sequencing.

verification.note: NCIT:C106049 ChIP-Seq; exact label match.

decisions.label: Spatial Transcriptome Analysis
decisions.description: A method that measures and maps gene expression in a biological sample while preserving the spatial context of the cells.

verification.note: NCIT:C205121 Spatial Transcriptome Analysis; Spatial-tx refers to spatial transcriptomics sequencing; the NCIT term is the parent concept for this library strategy class.

decisions.label: Single Nucleus ATAC-Seq
decisions.description: A molecular genetic technique where DNA is harvested from a single cell nucleus and subjected to ATAC-seq to isolate and sequence regions rich in open chromatin.

verification.note: NCIT:C198496 Single Nucleus ATAC-Seq; exact concept match for snATAC-Seq.

decisions.label: DNase-Seq
decisions.description: A molecular genetic technique where genome-wide sequencing is performed on DNA regions that are super sensitive to cleavage by DNase I to identify putative DNA regulatory sequences.

verification.note: NCIT:C106052 DNase-Seq; the vocab term 'DNase-Hypersensitivity' and NCIT label 'DNase-Seq' refer to the same technique. The vocabulary uses the older EBI SRA term for DNase I hypersensitive site sequencing.

decisions.label: Expressed Sequence Tag
decisions.description: Single-pass reads of 200-800 bp obtained from randomly selected clones from cDNA libraries, representing a snapshot of the genes expressed in a given tissue and/or at a given developmental stage for a given organism.

verification.note: NCIT:C18155 Expressed Sequence Tag; as a library strategy, EST refers to generating expressed sequence tags from a cDNA library. The NCIT term describes the resulting molecular marker rather than the sequencing strategy itself.

decisions.label: FAIRE-Seq
decisions.description: A molecular genetic technique that depletes a biological sample of nucleosomal DNA using formaldehyde-assisted isolation, then subjects the non-nucleosome-associated regulatory DNA to next-generation sequencing.

verification.note: NCIT:C106051 FAIRE-Seq; exact label match (case-insensitive).

decisions.label: Hi-C Sequencing
decisions.description: A DNA sequencing strategy designed to detect genome-wide chromatin interactions in the nucleus, based on Chromosome Conformation Capture with biotin-labeled ligation junctions.

verification.note: NCIT:C204819 Hi-C Sequencing; exact concept match for Hi-C library strategy.

decisions.label: Methyl-binding Domain Sequencing
decisions.description: A strategy to obtain DNA sequences from methylated sites by capturing methylated fragments with a protein with high affinity for double-stranded DNA harboring methylated CpGs, followed by sequencing.

verification.note: NCIT:C204820 Methyl-binding Domain Sequencing; exact concept match for MBD-Seq.

decisions.label: Methylated DNA Immunoprecipitation Sequencing
decisions.description: A strategy to obtain DNA sequences from methylated sites by immunoprecipitating methylated fragments with a monoclonal antibody that specifically recognizes 5-methylcytidine, followed by sequencing.

verification.note: NCIT:C204821 Methylated DNA Immunoprecipitation Sequencing; exact concept match for MeDIP-Seq.

decisions.label: MicroRNA Sequencing
decisions.description: A next-generation sequencing-based procedure that can identify and quantify the microRNA sequences present in a biological sample.

verification.note: NCIT:C156057 MicroRNA Sequencing; exact concept match for miRNA-Seq.

decisions.label: Non-Coding RNA Sequencing
decisions.description: A molecular genetic technique that can determine the RNA sequences for all or part of the population of small and large non-protein coding RNA transcripts in a sample.

verification.note: NCIT:C172858 Non-Coding RNA Sequencing; exact concept match for ncRNA-Seq.

decisions.label: Other
decisions.description: Different than the one(s) previously specified or mentioned.

verification.note: NCIT:C17649 Other; standard NCIT general qualifier.

decisions.label: Restriction-site Associated DNA Sequencing
decisions.description: A type of genome-wide sampling sequencing that reduces the complexity of the genome by subsampling only at specific sites defined by restriction enzymes.

verification.note: NCIT:C204824 Restriction-site Associated DNA Sequencing; exact concept match for RAD-Seq.

decisions.label: Direct Sequencing of RNA Immunoprecipitates
decisions.description: A method to recover and sequence interaction sites between RNA and specific RNA-binding proteins, using immunoprecipitation with antibodies targeted to the protein of interest followed by sequencing.

verification.note: NCIT:C204825 Direct Sequencing of RNA Immunoprecipitates; the NCIT label differs from the common abbreviation RIP-Seq but describes the same technique.

decisions.label: Whole Transcriptome Sequencing
decisions.description: A procedure that can determine the nucleotide sequence for all of the RNA transcripts in an individual.

verification.note: NCIT:C124261 Whole Transcriptome Sequencing; RNA-Seq as a library strategy typically refers to bulk mRNA/transcriptome sequencing. No dedicated NCIT 'RNA-Seq' class exists; this is the closest generic concept.

decisions.label: Systematic Evolution of Ligands by Exponential Enrichment
decisions.description: A method for isolating single-stranded DNAs or RNAs (aptamers) with high-affinity to a target molecule from a large library with random sequences through iterative rounds of selection and amplification.

verification.note: NCIT:C204826 Systematic Evolution of Ligands by Exponential Enrichment; SELEX is the selection technique; as a library strategy it refers to sequencing of SELEX-selected nucleic acid pools. The NCIT term matches the method but is not framed as a sequencing strategy.

decisions.label: DNA Sequencing
decisions.description: The determination of the sequence of purine and pyrimidine bases in a strand of DNA.

verification.note: NCIT:C153598 DNA Sequencing; exact concept match for generic DNA-Seq library strategy.

decisions.label: Next Generation Targeted Sequencing
decisions.description: A technique that determines the nucleotide sequence of a pre-specified region of DNA or RNA by using primers that are specific for that region.

verification.note: NCIT:C130177 Next Generation Targeted Sequencing; Targeted-Capture specifically uses capture probes (hybridization) rather than primers, but this is the closest NCIT concept for targeted sequencing of specific genomic regions.

decisions.label: Tethered Chromatin Conformation Capture Sequencing
decisions.description: A method for genome-wide mapping of chromatin interactions, similar to Hi-C sequencing except that the ligations are performed on a solid substrate rather than in solution, enhancing the signal-to-noise ratio.

verification.note: NCIT:C204829 Tethered Chromatin Conformation Capture Sequencing; exact concept match.

decisions.label: Transposon Sequencing
decisions.description: A method for accurately determining quantitative genetic interactions on a genome-wide scale in microorganisms, based on a saturated transposon insertion library followed by sequencing of flanking regions.

verification.note: NCIT:C204830 Transposon Sequencing; exact concept match for Tn-Seq.

decisions.label: Whole Genome Sequencing
decisions.description: A procedure that can determine the DNA sequence for nearly the entire genome of an individual.

verification.note: NCIT:C101294 Whole Genome Sequencing; exact concept match for WGS.

decisions.label: Whole Exome Sequencing
decisions.description: A procedure that can determine the DNA sequence for all of the exons in an individual.

verification.note: NCIT:C101295 Whole Exome Sequencing; exact concept match for WXS.
